SKILL_SOURCE:
git clone https://github.com/BlackVS/aiskills.git and read
aiskills/skills/oh-code-review/SKILL.md.
CLONE_AND_FETCH:
git clone https://github.com/{repo}.git (credentials are preconfigured),
git fetch origin refs/pull/{num}/head and diff it against the PR base
branch (gh pr view {num} --repo {repo} --json baseRefName shows it). Earlier
comments: gh pr view {num} --repo {repo} --comments.
POST_COMMAND:
gh pr comment {num} --repo {repo} --body-file review.md (gh is installed
and logged in).
